Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-polish-medium-0127-reverse-01", "row_sha256": "2ec7b493c5471e5785caed399dbcf445e55cec8c1ab53dc89e2d67820580480b", "mode": "/polish", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Rewrite awkward phrasing into readable prose for the supplied profile, or plain prose when none is supplied. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "for the tuesday dye log, i entered the indigo vat refill under batch 24-061, which was used for the navy cotton run at the east worktable. the supplier invoice came in after the shift, so the amount on the log was checked against that invoice this morning. the actual cost was $130.73, not $50.46. the lower figure was from the earlier estimate, and it should not be used as the cost for this refill.

mara recorded 18 liters added to the vat, and the refill was made before the first fabric roll went through. the invoice lists the dye concentrate and delivery together as one charge, so i kept the combined amount in the cost column rather than splitting it between materials and freight. i left the batch number and quantity as they were in the shift notes. this entry is only for the refill on tuesday; it does not cover the smaller top-up logged for the following morning. the invoice copy is clipped behind the page with the tuesday entries, where it can be checked against the written amount.", "output": "For the Tuesday dye log, I entered the indigo vat refill under batch 24-061. The actual cost was $130.73, not $50.46. The lower figure came from the earlier estimate and should not be used as the cost for this refill.

The invoice lists the dye concentrate and delivery together as one charge, so I kept the combined amount in the cost column rather than splitting it between materials and freight. I left the batch number and quantity as recorded in the shift notes. This entry is only for Tuesday’s refill; it does not cover the smaller top-up logged for the following morning. The invoice copy is clipped behind the page with the Tuesday entries, where it can be checked against the written amount."}]
